title: Pay in dollars abroad? Up to 12% extra #Shorts
description:
When a foreign card machine offers to charge you in your own currency (dynamic currency conversion), the rate usually carries a markup. A German consumer test found prices 2.6% to 12.0% higher when it was used.

Sources: Stiftung Warentest via Motley Fool (15 May 2023); Visa, Dynamic currency conversion page. Read 6 Nov 2026. Example numbers on screen are illustrations.
